verdict.rationale: PostHog publishes an OpenAPI spec at posthog.com/openapi.json and a hosted MCP server documented with 953 tools across 65 product categories, explicitly 'across every PostHog product'. A live probe shows 150 granular read/write OAuth scopes covering resources such as cohorts, alerts, batch exports and access control, and the CLI exposes the full API and MCP tool catalog headlessly. Together these strongly indicate broad API coverage of what the UI does. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity, and some account-provisioning gaps (wizard signup doesn't mint a personal API key; --ci mode is off in published builds).
